姓 名：林進傑
畢業年份：2017
就讀大學：香港中文大學
現 職：醫生
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery As a proud
graduate of Yung Yau College, I am delighted to contribute to the
school’s 25th anniversary publication. Looking back, my years
at Yung Yau were more than just a phase of academic learning.
They were a transformative period that shaped my character, ignited my ambitions, and laid the
foundation for my career as an emergency medicine physician.
When I first walked through the gates of Yung Yau, I was simply a young student filled with
curiosity but uncertain about my path. The school’s nurturing environment and dedicated teachers
gave me the confidence to explore my potential. I vividly remember the lessons that sparked my
enthusiasm for learning, as well as the encouragement from my teachers to ask questions and think
critically. Those moments in the classroom, coupled with the school’s emphasis on discipline and
resilience, planted the seeds of my dream to pursue medicine.
Beyond academics, Yung Yau taught me the value of compassion and service, qualities that
are at the heart of my work in emergency medicine. Whether through extracurricular activities,
community service, or simply the friendships among classmates, I learned the importance of
supporting others in times of need. These experiences have stayed with me and continue to guide
me as I navigate the high-pressure world of the emergency room, where quick thinking and empathy
are equally vital.
The 25th anniversary of Yung Yau College is a milestone that celebrates not only the institution
itself, but also the countless lives it has touched. I am deeply grateful for the teachers who believed
in me, the friends who became my second family, and the opportunities that pushed me to grow.
Yung Yau gave me the tools to face challenges with courage and the heart to serve others with
kindness.
As I reflect on my journey, I am filled with pride in our school’s legacy and optimism for its
future. To the students of Yung Yau today, I encourage you to embrace every opportunity, learn from
every setback, and cherish the moments you share in this special place. Congratulations to Yung
Yau College on 25 years of excellence, and thank you for shaping me into the person I am today.
姓 名：蔡培琳
畢業年份：2021
就讀大學：香港中文大學
現 職：碩士學生（倫敦大學學院）
值此母校 25 周年校慶之際，我的心彷彿又回到了那個充滿
陽光與歡樂的校園。
作為當年科研小組的一分子，那些課後與同學和崔老師在實
驗室並肩作戰的日子，如今想起來，仍然記憶猶新。母校不單教
會了我們知識，更以無盡的耐心與支持，點燃了我們對未知的好
奇。每一次科研實驗的起與落、每一次站在比賽領獎台上的感動與歡呼，都是學校和老師們用
愛與時間澆灌出來的成果。
25 年來，母校從青澀走到如今的豐盛，我們這些散落在世界各地的校友，卻始終帶着翁
中的溫暖前行。在此，我衷心祝福翁祐中學 25 歲生日快樂！願「文、行、忠、信」的火炬代
代相傳，繼續照亮更多學生的道路，賦予他們一顆敢夢、敢闖的心。
￼
￼
85
Shun Tak Fraternal Association Yung Yau College
